message.content:
**www.profedcreditunion.com** appears to be a misspelling or alternate reference to **ProFed Credit Union’s official website**, which is **profedcu.org**.[2][4][5]

ProFed Credit Union is a financial institution based in **Fort Wayne, Indiana**, with **13 branch locations** in northeast Indiana.[1][2] Its website says membership is available to people who live, work, worship, attend school, volunteer, or regularly do business in **Adams, Allen, DeKalb, Huntington, LaGrange, Noble, Steuben, Wells, and Whitley counties**.[2]

If you meant the credit union’s website, use **profedcu.org** rather than **www.profedcreditunion.com**.[2][4][5]
